'''''Yllama''''' was a [[Strike-class medium cruiser]] used by [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]]. The cruiser would arrive at a [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defender]] staging area used by the pirates that was destroyed by two [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Missile Boat]]s, after the [[CR90 corvette/Legends|corvettes]] ''[[Xtram]]'' and [[CR92a Assassin-class corvette|modified corvette]] ''[[Holdon]]'' were destroyed. The cruiser launched [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunters]], [[R-41 Starchaser]]s and [[TIE/ad starfighter|TIE Avengers]]. The cruiser would then be destroyed by the two Missile Boats.
